bench: Zero engine errors; 1 world; the campaign-2 shelf archives fetched under campaign 2's principal (8 organisms kept, held-out 0.5625, per-ask 0.65/0.48); 24 records; 24 reachability rows with per-ask held-out; 12 corridor rows (shelf organisms -> W2_K2, dose 4: 12 SHELF, 0 SUMMIT). Bench notes: (1) the run took 1226 s for 24 x 300 generations on 12 processes (about 4x the campaign-2 rate per generation: the per-ask credit, the 300-generation traces and 12 concurrent processes on a 12-core box); a 24-run G300 scan is the largest single job of three campaigns and still under half an hour; (2) 'stream profile' from a 16-episode training battery is not a lineage property when the strategy is last-value; the anatomy needs a per-episode probe against the last PUT value (added to C3-SFE-02 before it runs); (3) the ladder points were read off one trace per seed through the monotone lookup, as designed: no rerun per budget.
disposition_note: Assay capable (fresh 11/12 on the shelf); 0/24 confirmed summits and 0 candidates through G300, both arms; shelf residence censored at 300 in every shelf run. The summit of W2_K2 is OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE at every ladder point up to G300 under the current system (95% upper band 0.22 at n=14). C3-SFE-08's premise (a meaningful full-solve regime) is dead: replaced (D3-013).
landscape: W2_K2 4-bit N200 E16: FLOOR -> SHELF in 11/12 seeds by G300 (median ~90 generations; the campaign-2 'plateau with a late exit' is the same shape stretched: 4/12 by G60); SHELF -> SUMMIT never in 24 x 300 generations (0/14 baseline at G300). The shelf's best training reward saturates at 0.59-0.69 (19-22 of 32 asks) with rare excursions to 0.81-0.875; end-of-run held-out 0.50-0.60 with per-ask ~0.5/0.5. Two runs reached a both-streams profile on the training battery (0.875 = 28/32 at generation 294 in seed 11) without a held-out above 0.61: whatever partial two-stream competence appears, it is not the keyed recall the summit needs. The reachability table's summit level for W2_K2 is now OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE_AT_BUDGET through G300.
science: MAJOR RESULT, RECORDED WITH ITS CENSORING: zero confirmed summits and zero training-only candidates in 24 runs of 300 generations on W2_K2 4-bit (N=200, E=16). Assay capable: the fresh arm reached the SHELF in 11 of 12 seeds (first shelf at generations 13-226, median ~90; at the ladder points 4/12 by G60, 7/12 by G100, 9/12 by G150, 10/12 by G200, 11/12 by G300), so the population climbs onto the shelf routinely and then stays: shelf residence 74-287 generations, every one censored at G=300. Best training reward over 300 generations was 0.59-0.69 in 10 of 11 shelf runs and 0.81 / 0.875 in two (seeds 3 and 11; 26 and 28 of 32 asks in one battery), never 0.90; end-of-run held-out 0.50-0.60. The SHELF arm (four preserved campaign-2 shelf organisms substituted into generation 0) sat on the shelf from generation 0 in 12/12 seeds and produced no summit either (best 0.625-0.81; the imports took the population over, import share 1.0 in every seed, D3-005's cap deliberately off). The machine candidate CAPABLE_NEGATIVE for the primary (shelf-start vs fresh on summit frequency: 0/12 vs 0/12) is accepted, and the reachability table now reads W2_K2 4-bit N200 summit OBSERVED_UNREACHABLE_AT_BUDGET at every ladder point with 14 baseline runs at G300 (95% band < 0.22; < 0.13 including the shelf arm's 12 treated runs). Timescale: none measurable; the shelf-to-summit transition did not occur within 300 generations under this organism/evaluator/search system. Exploratory shape (the anatomy is C3-SFE-02's job): (i) end-of-run held-out per ask position is ~0.5 / ~0.5 for almost every elite (e.g. 0.56/0.52, 0.42/0.60, 0.50/0.50), not 1.0 / 0.0 -- the shelf elite does not solve ONE stream; it answers each ask correctly about half the time, which is what an organism that outputs the LAST PUT value does when the asked stream is the last-written one half the time; (ii) the training-battery 'stream profile' of the elite flips between 01 and 10 across generations (0-6 flips per run) and briefly shows 11 in 4 runs (seed 11: 18 generations, best 0.875 at 294, held-out 0.60), so the 'switching' is mostly battery luck on a last-value strategy, with two runs showing real two-stream progress that never reached 0.9; (iii) the shelf is not absorbing: after first reaching it, elites spent 42, 61 and 105 generations back below 0.45 in three seeds (regression), i.e. the training best fluctuates across the shelf boundary. Must NOT be claimed: that a summit is impossible (band < 0.22 at G300; N and E were fixed); that the shelf is 'one stream solved' (the per-ask data say last-value); anything about mechanism before C3-SFE-02.
